title: Host answers the test launcher's registration POST slowly under load; a focused run aborted at the 8 s registration budget
outcome: Launcher registration (the host's test-run registration endpoint) answers well within its 8 s budget under normal multi-lane load, and the cause of the slow post_headers phase is diagnosed and fixed in the host (lock contention, writer queue, or similar). The registration budget is not inflated to hide it, per the repository's no-inflated-timeouts rule.
acceptance: Host answers the test launcher's registration POST slowly under load; a focused run aborted at the 8 s registration budget is done
